items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: along with the fact that I started playing in the orchestra with Bunk Johnson

ctx.x: What kind of a person was he?

He was a very nice man and very jovial, very, very humorous, very humorous man. I can remember he used to keep everybody laughing all the time with these old jokes. You know, one of the most marvelous things that I can remember about people like Bunk Johnson, Pat, you know, one of the most wonderful things that I can remember is to have worked around people with humor, with a sense of humor.
